title: Personal Finance Foundations
promise: Get your money organized in a weekend.
summary: Most money problems are not maths problems. They are a missing system, plus a lot of quiet dread about looking at the numbers. This is a calm, no-jargon setup you can build in a weekend: a two-week spending audit that ends, an order of operations that tells you what to fund next, and a set of automatic transfers that keep working long after your motivation runs out.
